name: Antipsychotics: D2 Blockade, EPS and Clozapine

reference.source: KD Tripathi Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Mesolimbic D2 blockade quiets psychosis while nigrostriatal blockade freezes movement and tuberoinfundibular blockade milks prolactin; clozapine spares striatum but neutropenias marrow demanding counts, and VMAT2 inhibition calms tardive chorea.
